fieldValues.title: A decision is shown where it removes no choices, because its level and domain are not recorded
fieldValues.statement: A decision removes future choices only in the domain where it is relevant. Ours do not say where that is, so technical choices land in my strategy sessions as noise, and I cannot see which boundaries keep being hit or where a domain is missing.
source_ref: Finding: no decision records the level or boundary where it removes choices (2026-10-28)
